title: Brothers' saxophone, clarinet and bands
summary: He first saw saxophones in World War One; his brothers played with the Day Range band and with the young Morgan band before Sam took over.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: When did the saxophone come out for your brother to play?
Well them saxophones, I didn't know anything about saxophones until the time of World War One. That's the time I did saxophones, the first time I would see them saxophones, World War One.
Did he play anything before he played saxophones? Oh my brother?
Yes. Oh yeah, he played clannic. Oh I see. He played clannic. Yeah.
And which bands would they play with?
Well my brother, he played with the Derange band at the time then. All of them? My oldest brother. Oh your oldest brother. Yeah. My brother Sam was playing the band with me and Isaiah Morgan.

We were at the Young Morgan band at the time then. Before Sam took the band in charge. Young Morgan band. Me and my brother, and Lil Jim played with Eddie Pearson, well he was playing bass, you understand?
And who would Effie play with?
He was playing the Derange band too. We're about out of tape.
